concept: EC2 purchasing: Savings Plans/RI discount for steady 24/7 load
tests: Choosing a purchasing option for a constant production workload over 3+ years.
expected: 3-year Compute Savings Plan or Reserved Instances — maximum discount for predictable load. Triggers: "steady-state", "24/7", "at least three years".
why_not: Spot gets interrupted — not for steady production; On-Demand is more expensive; On-Demand Dedicated Hosts — the most expensive option.
